# Waveroom

> > Waveroom is a browser-based remote recording studio for capturing 4K video and WAV audio podcasts, interviews, and meetings with AI-powered denoising and transcription.

Developed by OmniSale GmbH in Switzerland, Waveroom enables content creators to record high-quality remote conversations with local recording technology, supporting formats like MP4, WAV, and MKV across browsers including Safari. The platform integrates AI features such as noise removal via LALAL.AI Voice Cleaner and automatic transcription.

## Key Topics

- Remote recording
- 4K video recording
- WAV audio format
- AI-powered denoising
- Podcast recording
- Local recording technology
- Browser-based recording
- Video conferencing
- Transcription services
- MP4 and MKV formats
- High-quality audio
- LALAL.AI Voice Cleaner
- Audio-only recording
- Noise removal
- Safari support

- [Online Remote Recording Studio | Waveroom](https://www.waveroom.com): Homepage: Remote recording studio for 4K video/WAV audio podcasts & meetings

- [Record Video Online for Free | Waveroom](https://www.waveroom.com/online-video-record): Free online video recorder with 2K resolution browser-based recording
- [Record Your Voice Online for Free | Waveroom](https://www.waveroom.com/online-voice-recorder): Free online voice recorder tool for high-quality browser-based audio
- [Test Your Camera Online for Free | Waveroom](https://www.waveroom.com/camera-online): Free webcam test tool with MP4/MKV recording in browser (Safari supported)
